mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_category WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_category (store_id, name, icon, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{name}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_category name = #{name},icon = #{icon}, sort_order = #{sortOrder},status = #{status}, WHERE id = #{id}
